note: Majority: the Civil Code of the Republic of Tajikistan (part one, as SoyuzPravoInform's database holds it, with amendments to 2016), article 22(1): full civil capacity from majority, at eighteen; marriage before 18 gives it earlier (article 22(2)), not held. Whether a newer Civil Code has replaced part one wasn't checked. Work: the only Labour Code text found on that database is the 1997 Code (edition of 25 March 2011), which the Labour Code of 23 July 2016 replaced; it wasn't used, and the 2016 Code wasn't found (the Ministry of Justice's legal database adlia.tj and the Ministry of Labour's site didn't answer); left null. Service: the law on universal military duty wasn't found; left null.

sources.title: Законодательство стран СНГ (СоюзПравоИнформ): Гражданский кодекс Республики Таджикистан (часть первая)
sources.said: (гражданская дееспособность) возникает в полном объеме с наступлением совершеннолетия, то есть по достижении восемнадцатилетнего возраста.
